B1.title: O'tmishdagi voqea paytida
B1.can: O'tmishda bir ish davom etayotganda nima bo'lganini hikoya qila olaman
B1.grammar: O'tgan davomli zamon — was/were + -ing, while va when bilan (Past Continuous)
B1.explain:
Formula: was/were + fe'l + -ing · uzoq ish → Past Continuous, uni bo'lgan qisqa ish → Past Simple
Misol: I was walking home when the accident happened. — Uyga ketayotgandim, shunda hodisa yuz berdi.
Misol: While she was sleeping, the phone rang. — U uxlayotganda telefon jiringladi.

lesson.rule:
O'tmishda bir ish uzoq davom etayotganda, boshqa bir qisqa ish sodir bo'lganini aytish uchun Past Continuous va Past Simple zamonlarini birga ishlatamiz.

Formula:
Uzoq ish: was/were + fe'l + -ing (Past Continuous)
Qisqa ish: V2 / fe'lning o'tgan zamon shakli (Past Simple)

Bog'lovchilar:
• WHEN — odatda qisqa ish (Past Simple) oldidan keladi.
• WHILE — odatda uzoq ish (Past Continuous) oldidan keladi.

O'zbek tilidan farqi: O'zbek tilida 'uxlayotganda' deb birgina so'z ishlatilsa, ingliz tilida 'while she was sleeping' deb to'liq zamon tuzilishi talab qilinadi.

examples.en: I was walking home when the accident happened.
examples.uz: Uyga ketayotgandim, shunda baxtsiz hodisa yuz berdi.
examples.note: Uzoq harakat davom etdi, qisqa ish uni to'xtatdi.

examples.en: While she was sleeping, the phone rang.
examples.uz: U uxlayotganda telefon jiringladi.
examples.note: While so'zidan keyin har doim -ing keladi.

examples.en: The driver was shouting while the passengers were panicking.
examples.uz: Yo'lovchilar vahima qilayotgan paytda haydovchi baqirayotgandi.
examples.note: Ikki uzoq ish bir vaqtda davom etmoqda.

examples.en: A brave witness called an ambulance when the crash occurred.
examples.uz: To'qnashuv sodir bo'lganda, jasur guvoh tez yordam chaqirdi.
examples.note: When so'zidan keyin Past Simple ishlatildi.

practice.q: While I ___ home, I saw a terrible accident.
The passenger was sleeping when the bus ___.
A doctor came quickly to ___ the injured people.

B1.title: Ilgari shunday qilardim
B1.can: O'tmishdagi odatlarim haqida, endi u qanday o'zgarganini ayta olaman
B1.grammar: O'tmishdagi odat — used to va would, hozirgi holat bilan solishtirish (used to / would)
B1.explain:
Formula: used to + fe'l (o'tmishdagi odat yoki holat) · would + fe'l (faqat takrorlangan harakat)
Misol: I used to live in a village. — Men ilgari qishloqda yashardim.
Misol: Every summer we would visit our grandmother. — Har yozda buvimiznikiga borardik.

lesson.rule:
O'tmishdagi takroriy odatlar va holatlar uchun 'used to' yoki 'would' ishlatamiz.

1. Formula: used to + fe'l.
Barcha shaxslar uchun bir xil. O'tmishda doim bajarilgan, lekin hozirda tugatilgan ish-harakatlar yoki holatlar uchun (masalan: yashash, yoqtirish) qo'llaniladi.

2. Formula: would + fe'l.
Faqat o'tmishdagi TAKRORLANUVCHI harakatlar uchun ishlatiladi. HOLAT FE'LLARIGA (masalan: live, like, have) 'would' ISHLATILMAYDI! O'zbek tilida bu asosan '-ardi' qo'shimchasi orqali ifodalanadi.

O'zbek tilidan farqi: Biz o'tmishdagi odatni oddiy o'tgan zamon (Past Simple) bilan ham aytishimiz mumkin, lekin 'used to' uning odat bo'lganini aniq ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: I used to live in the countryside when I was a teenager.
examples.uz: Men o'smir paytimda qishloqda yashardim.
examples.note: 'live' holat fe'li bo'lgani uchun 'used to' shart.

examples.en: Every summer my grandfather would take me to the playground.
examples.uz: Har yoz bobom meni o'yin maydonchasiga olib borardi.

examples.en: She used to play with her doll in the yard.
examples.uz: U hovlida qo'g'irchog'i bilan o'ynar edi.

examples.en: We would eat many sweets after school.
examples.uz: Biz maktabdan keyin ko'p shirinliklar yerdik.

practice.q: When I was a child, I _____ live in a small house.
My grandfather _____ have a red car, but now he has a modern scooter.
My younger _____ always shared his toys with me.

B1.title: Undan ham oldin bo'lgan ish
B1.can: Ikki o'tmish voqeasidan qaysi biri oldin bo'lganini aniq ayta olaman
B1.grammar: O'tgan mukammal zamon — had + III shakl, before/after/already bilan (Past Perfect)
B1.explain:
Formula: had + fe'lning III shakli — o'tmishdagi ikkinchi voqeadan OLDIN bo'lgan ish
Misol: When I arrived, the train had already left. — Men yetib borganimda, poyezd allaqachon ketgan edi.
Misol: She realised she had forgotten her keys. — U kalitlarini unutganini angladi.

lesson.rule:
O'tgan zamonda ikkita ish bo'lganda, ulardan OLDIN sodir bo'lganini aytish uchun Past Perfect ishlatiladi.
Formula: ega + had + fe'lning III shakli (past participle).
O'zbek tilida bu '...gan edi' deb tarjima qilinadi.
Diqqat qiling: o'zbek tilida bitta zamon bilan ham tushunilaveradi, lekin ingliz tilida qaysi ish oldin bo'lganini ko'rsatish uchun 'had' shart.
'Before' va 'already' so'zlari ko'p qo'llanadi.

examples.en: When I arrived, the train had already left.
examples.uz: Men yetib borganimda, poyezd allaqachon ketgan edi.
examples.note: Poyezd ketishi siz borishdan oldin sodir bo'lgan.

examples.en: She realised she had forgotten her keys.
examples.uz: U kalitlarini unutganini angladi.
examples.note: Unutish harakati anglashdan oldin yuz bergan.

examples.en: He returned home after the rain had stopped.
examples.uz: U yomg'ir to'xtagandan keyin uyga qaytdi.

examples.en: They had warned us previously about the traffic.
examples.uz: Ular bizni oldinroq tirbandlik haqida ogohlantirishgan edi.
examples.note: Ogohlantirish o'tmishdagi boshqa ishdan oldin bo'lgan.

practice.q: By the time we got to the cinema, the film ___ started.
She was sad because her favourite ring ___.
What does 'realise' mean in Uzbek?

B1.title: Qancha vaqtdan beri
B1.can: Boshlangan va hali davom etayotgan ish haqida, qancha vaqtligini ayta olaman
B1.grammar: Hozirgi mukammal davomli zamon — have/has been + -ing, for va since bilan (Present Perfect Continuous)
B1.explain:
Formula: have/has been + fe'l + -ing · for + davomiylik, since + boshlangan payt
Misol: I have been learning English for two years. — Ikki yildan beri ingliz tilini o'rganyapman.
Misol: She has been working since morning. — U ertalabdan beri ishlayapti.

lesson.rule:
O'tmishda boshlanib, hozir ham davom etayotgan va ayniqsa qancha vaqtdan beri davom etayotganini ko'rsatish uchun Present Perfect Continuous ishlatamiz.

Formula: I/We/You/They + have been + fe'l(-ing)
He/She/It + has been + fe'l(-ing)

Zamon so'zlari:
• for — davomiylik uchun (masalan: for two years — ikki yildan beri)
• since — ish boshlangan aniq vaqt uchun (masalan: since morning — ertalabdan beri)

O'zbek tilida bu '...dan beri ...yapman' deb tarjima qilinadi. E'tibor bering, o'zbek tilida oddiy hozirgi zamon ishlatilsa ham, ingliz tilida jarayon hali davom etayotgani uchun -ing qo'shimchasi shart.

examples.en: I have been learning English for two years.
examples.uz: Ikki yildan beri ingliz tilini o'rganyapman.

examples.en: She has been working since morning.
examples.uz: U ertalabdan beri ishlayapti.

examples.en: We have been trying to manage our time better.
examples.uz: Biz vaqtimizni yaxshiroq boshqarishga harakat qilyapmiz.

examples.en: He has been practising guitar constantly.
examples.uz: U doimiy ravishda gitara mashq qilyapti.

practice.q: She ___ studying for her exams since 8 o'clock.
I have ___ working on this project for three hours.
We need more ___ to accomplish this difficult task.

B1.title: Qaysi odam, qaysi joy
B1.can: Odam yoki narsani qo'shimcha gap bilan aniqlab tasvirlab bera olaman
B1.explain:
Qoida: who = odam · which = narsa · that = ikkalasi · where = joy · whose = kimningdir
Misol: The man who lives next door is a doctor. — Yonimizda yashaydigan kishi shifokor.
Misol: This is the school where I studied. — Bu men o'qigan maktab.

lesson.rule:
Odam yoki narsani aniqlab tasvirlash uchun relative clauses (aniqlovchi ergash gaplar) ishlatiladi.

Formulalar:
• Odam uchun: who / that (The person who/that helps me...)
• Narsa/joy uchun: which / that (The book which/that I read...)
• Joy uchun: where (The city where I live...)
• Egalik uchun: whose (The man whose car was stolen...)

O'zbek tilidan farqi: O'zbek tilida aniqlovchi fe'l-sifat shaklida (-gan) egadan oldin keladi ('kitob o'qigan bola'). Ingliz tilida esa bu so'zlar gapning oxiriga, asosiy so'zdan keyin qo'shiladi ('the boy who read a book'). Buni adashtirmaslik muhim!

examples.en: The man who lives next door is a doctor.
examples.uz: Yonimizda yashaydigan kishi shifokor.

examples.en: This is the school where I studied.
examples.uz: Bu men o'qigan maktab.

examples.en: I met an engineer whose work is amazing.
examples.uz: Men ishi ajoyib bo'lgan muhandis bilan uchrashdim.

examples.en: She works in a building which is very old.
examples.uz: U juda qadimiy bo'lgan binoda ishlaydi.

practice.q: The scientist ___ discovered the new medicine won a prize.
This is the library ___ I read books every weekend.
A person who is new in your neighbourhood and you do not know is a ___.

B1.title: Agar shunday bo'lganda edi
B1.can: Xayoliy vaziyat va orzularim haqida gapira olaman
B1.grammar: Ikkinchi shart gap — if + Past Simple, would + fe'l (Second Conditional)
B1.explain:
Formula: If + Past Simple, would + fe'l — real emas, xayoliy vaziyat
Misol: If I had more time, I would learn two languages. — Vaqtim ko'proq bo'lganda, ikkita til o'rganardim.
Misol: If I were you, I would accept the offer. — Sizning o'rningizda bo'lsam, taklifni qabul qilardim.

lesson.rule:
Xayoliy vaziyat va orzular haqida gapirish uchun Second Conditional ishlatiladi.
Formula: If + Past Simple, would + fe'l (asosiy shakli).
O'zbek tilida '...gan bo'lardim' yoki '...r edim' deb tarjima qilinadi. 
Diqqat qiling: o'zbek tilidan farqli ravishda, ingliz tilida 'if' qismida ham o'tgan zamon (Past Simple) ishlatiladi, garchi gap hozirgi yoki kelasi zamon haqida bo'lsa ham. Shuningdek, barcha shaxslar (I, he, she) uchun 'was' emas, ko'pincha 'were' ishlatiladi (masalan: If I were you...).

examples.en: If I had more time, I would learn two languages.
examples.uz: Vaqtim ko'proq bo'lganda, ikkita til o'rganardim.

examples.en: If I were you, I would accept the opportunity.
examples.uz: Sizning o'rningizda bo'lsam, imkoniyatni qabul qilardim.
examples.note: If dan keyin was emas, were ishlatiladi.

examples.en: If I had great wealth, I would travel everywhere.
examples.uz: Katta boyligim bo'lganda, hamma yoqqa sayohat qilgan bo'lardim.
examples.note: Would dan keyin fe'l o'zgarishsiz keladi.

examples.en: If I had enough courage, I would not hesitate.
examples.uz: Yetarli jasoratim bo'lganda, ikkilanmagan bo'lardim.

practice.q: If I _____ rich, I would buy a big house.
What would you do if you _____ this opportunity?
Choose the correct translation for: 'Agar imkoniyatim bo'lsa, buni ko'rib chiqardim.'
options: If I have a chance, I will consider this.
If I had a chance, I would consider this.
If I had a chance, I consider this.

B1.title: Boshqaning gapini yetkazish
B1.can: Kimdir aytgan gapni o'z so'zlarim bilan yetkaza olaman
B1.grammar: O'zga gap — say/tell va zamonning bir qadam orqaga surilishi (reported speech)
B1.explain:
Qoida: zamon bir qadam orqaga suriladi (am/is → was, will → would, can → could)
Misol: "I am tired." → He said he was tired. — U charchaganini aytdi.
Misol: "I will call you." → She said she would call me. — U qo'ng'iroq qilishini aytdi.

lesson.rule:
Boshqaning gapini yetkazishda (Reported Speech) zamonlar bir qadam o'tmishga suriladi.

Formulasi: Subject + said/told (that) + orqaga surilgan zamon.
Misollar: Present Simple (I work) -> Past Simple (He worked) bo'ladi. Present Continuous (is working) esa Past Continuous (was working) ga o'zgaradi. Modal fe'llardan will -> would, can -> could bo'ladi.

Diqqat qiling: 'Say' dan keyin to'g'ridan-to'g'ri shaxs kelmaydi (He said me - xato), 'tell' dan keyin esa shaxs kelishi shart (He told me - to'g'ri). O'zbek tilida biz zamonni o'zgartirmaymiz, ingliz tilida esa bu qoida shart.

examples.en: He announced that he was ready for the speech.
examples.uz: U nutqqa tayyor ekanligini e'lon qildi.
examples.note: is -> was bo'lib bir qadam orqaga surildi.

examples.en: She told me that she would suggest a new plan.
examples.uz: U menga yangi reja taklif qilishini aytdi.
examples.note: will -> would bo'ldi va tell dan keyin me keldi.

examples.en: They claimed that it was a secret truth.
examples.uz: Ular bu sirli haqiqat ekanligini da'vo qilishdi.

examples.en: He said he could not share private information.
examples.uz: U shaxsiy ma'lumotni ulasha olmasligini aytdi.

practice.q: She ... me that she was honest.
He said, "I will call." -> He said he ... call.
We need to ... a new idea during the conversation.

B1.title: Qurilgan, yaratilgan, buzilgan
B1.can: Ish kim tomonidan bajarilganini ta'kidlamasdan bayon qila olaman
B1.grammar: Majhul nisbat — o'tgan va kelasi zamonda: was made / will be built (passive: past and future)
B1.explain:
Formula: was/were + III shakl (o'tgan) · will be + III shakl (kelasi)
Misol: The bridge was built in 1990. — Ko'prik 1990-yilda qurilgan.
Misol: The results will be published tomorrow. — Natijalar ertaga e'lon qilinadi.

lesson.rule:
Ishni kim bajargani muhim bo'lmaganda yoki noma'lum bo'lganda majhul nisbat (passive) ishlatiladi.
O'tgan zamon uchun: was/were + fe'lning 3-shakli (Past Participle).
Kelasi zamon uchun: will be + fe'lning 3-shakli.
O'zbek tilida bu '-il', '-in' qo'shimchalari orqali yasaladi (masalan: qurildi).
Diqqat: Ingliz tilida egadan keyin to'g'ridan-to'g'ri fe'l kelmaydi, albatta yordamchi fe'l (was/were yoki will be) va asosiy fe'lning 3-shakli shart. O'quvchilar ko'pincha was dan keyin oddiy fe'l ishlatib adashishadi.

examples.en: The bridge was built in 1990.
examples.uz: Ko'prik 1990-yilda qurilgan.
examples.note: O'tgan zamon uchun was + built ishlatildi.

examples.en: The results will be published tomorrow.
examples.uz: Natijalar ertaga e'lon qilinadi.
examples.note: Kelasi zamon uchun will be + published.

examples.en: Old equipment was replaced last week.
examples.uz: Eski jihozlar o'tgan hafta almashtirildi.
examples.note: equipment sanalmaydigan ot — shuning uchun was.

examples.en: New technology will be installed soon.
examples.uz: Yangi texnologiya tez orada o'rnatiladi.

practice.q: The old factory _____ destroyed by the storm last year.
New houses _____ constructed in our town next year.
Solar energy is used to protect the _____.

B1.title: Shunday bo'lsa kerak
B1.can: Dalillarga tayanib taxmin va xulosa ayta olaman
B1.grammar: Taxmin modallari — must be / might be / can't be (modals of deduction)
B1.explain:
Qoida: must be = deyarli aniq · might/may be = ehtimol · can't be = bo'lishi mumkin emas
Misol: He must be at home — his car is here. — U uyda bo'lsa kerak, mashinasi shu yerda.
Misol: This can't be the right answer. — Bu to'g'ri javob bo'lishi mumkin emas.

lesson.rule:
Biz dalillarga tayanib xulosa chiqarish uchun modal fe'llardan foydalanamiz.
Formula: Egachi + must be / might be / can't be + sifat/ot/fe'l.
1. Must be — dalilga asoslanib, biror narsa 100% rost bo'lishi kerakligiga amin bo'lganimizda ishlatiladi.
2. Might be — ehtimol bor, lekin aniq bilmaymiz.
3. Can't be — dalillarga ko'ra, bu imkonsiz yoki mantiqsiz ekanini bildiradi (mumkin emas).
Diqqat! O'zbek tilida 'bo'lishi kerak' deganda biz ko'pincha shartni tushunamiz, lekin bu yerda gap isbotga tayanib taxmin qilish haqida ketmoqda. 'Must not' taqiqni bildiradi, shuning uchun salbiy taxmin uchun faqat 'can't be' ishlatiladi.

examples.en: He must be at home, his car is here.
examples.uz: U uyda bo'lsa kerak, mashinasi shu yerda.
examples.note: Mashina turgani uchun aniq ishonch bor.

examples.en: This can't be the right answer, it is completely illogical.
examples.uz: Bu to'g'ri javob bo'lishi mumkin emas, u butunlay mantiqsiz.
examples.note: Mantiqsizligi uchun uning to'g'riligi rad etilyapti.

examples.en: She might be tired after such a long journey.
examples.uz: U shuncha uzun yo'ldan keyin charchagan bo'lishi ehtimol.

examples.en: This mysterious clue indicates a hidden reason.
examples.uz: Bu sirli ishora yashirin sababdan dalolat qiladi.

practice.q: The lights are on and I can hear music. They ___ at home.
His story ___ true. He has no proof at all.
Based on the evidence, what do we call a final decision we make?

B1.title: Qilishni yoqtiraman
B1.can: Qiziqishlarim va niyatlarim haqida to'g'ri fe'l shakli bilan gapira olaman
B1.grammar: Gerundiy va infinitiv — enjoy doing / decide to do (gerunds and infinitives)
B1.explain:
Qoida: enjoy, mind, avoid, quit → fe'l + ing · decide, want, hope, intend → to + fe'l
Misol: I enjoy playing chess. — Shaxmat o'ynashni yoqtiraman.
Misol: She decided to study abroad. — U chet elda o'qishga qaror qildi.

lesson.rule:
Ingliz tilida bir fe'ldan keyin ikkinchi fe'l kelganda, ikkinchisi ikki xil shaklda kelishi mumkin: gerundiy (-ing) yoki infinitiv (to + fe'l).

1. enjoy, mind, quit, delay kabi so'zlardan keyin doim -ing qo'shimchasi qo'shiladi. Masalan: I enjoy painting. (Men rassomchilikni yoqtiraman)
2. decide, want, hope, intend, afford kabi so'zlardan keyin esa to + fe'l ishlatiladi. Masalan: She decided to buy a guitar. (U gitara sotib olishga qaror qildi)

O'zbek tilida '...shni' yoki '...vchi' deb tarjima qilinsada, ingliz tilida qaysi fe'ldan keyin nima kelishini yodlab qolish kerak.

examples.en: I really enjoy painting in my free time.
examples.uz: Bo'sh vaqtimda rassomchilik qilishdan rohatlanaman.

examples.en: She decided to study photography next month.
examples.uz: U kelasi oydan fotografiya o'qishga qaror qildi.
examples.note: decide fe'lidan keyin to + fe'l ishlatiladi.

examples.en: He wants to learn how to play the piano.
examples.uz: U pianino chalishni o'rganishni xohlaydi.
examples.note: want fe'lidan keyin to + fe'l keladi.

examples.en: They finally quit smoking and saved money.
examples.uz: Ular oxiri chekishni tashlashdi va pul tejashdi.

practice.q: Do you enjoy _______ chess with your friends?
We intend _______ an exhibition of modern art this weekend.
My new hobby is _______, especially taking pictures of nature.

B1.title: Boshqacha bo'lganda edi
B1.can: O'tmishdagi afsus va bo'lishi mumkin bo'lgan natija haqida gapira olaman
B1.grammar: Uchinchi shart gap va wish — if + had + III shakl, would have + III shakl (Third Conditional)
B1.explain:
Formula: If + had + III shakl, would have + III shakl — o'tmishni o'zgartirib bo'lmaydi
Misol: If I had studied harder, I would have passed. — Ko'proq o'qiganimda, o'tgan bo'lardim.
Misol: I wish I had told the truth. — Qaniydi rostini aytganimda.

lesson.rule:
O'tmishdagi afsus va bo'lmagan voqealar haqida gapirish uchun Third Conditional (Uchinchi shart gap) ishlatiladi.
Formula: If + had + fe'lning 3-shakli (V3), would have + fe'lning 3-shakli (V3).
Bu qolip o'tmishda sodir bo'lgan voqeani o'zgartirib bo'lmasligini va uning natijasi boshqacha bo'lmaganini bildiradi.
Shuningdek, 'I wish + had + V3' o'tmishdagi afsuslar uchun ishlatiladi.
O'zbek tilida bu '...ganimda, ...gan bo'lar edim' deb tarjima qilinadi. O'zbek tilidan farqli ravishda, ingliz tilida 'if' qismida 'would' ishlatilmaydi, faqat 'had' keladi. O'quvchilar ko'pincha 'If I would have' deb xato qilishadi.

examples.en: If I had studied harder, I would have passed the exam.
examples.uz: Agar qattiroq o'qiganimda, imtihondan o'tgan bo'lar edim.

examples.en: I wish I had made a better decision.
examples.uz: Qaniydi yaxshiroq qaror qabul qilganimda.

examples.en: If it had not been for the bad circumstance, we would have won.
examples.uz: Agar yomon sharoit bo'lmaganida, biz yutgan bo'lar edik.

examples.en: She would have been happy if she had taken that option.
examples.uz: Agar u o'sha variantni tanlaganida, baxtli bo'lar edi.
examples.note: Natija oldinda, shart ortda kelishi mumkin.

practice.q: If she _____ earlier, she would have caught the train.
I wish I _____ the responsibility for that mistake.
What is the best translation for 'afsuski'?

B1.title: Kelajak rejalari va bashorat
B1.can: Kelajak haqida turli shakllarni farqlab ishlata olaman
B1.grammar: Kelasi zamon shakllarini solishtirish — will / be going to / Present Continuous (future forms)
B1.explain:
Qoida: will = taxmin va shu zahoti qaror · going to = oldindan niyat · Present Continuous = kelishilgan uchrashuv
Misol: I am meeting the client at five. — Soat beshda mijoz bilan uchrashaman (kelishilgan).
Misol: I think the economy will grow. — Menimcha, iqtisodiyot o'sadi (taxmin).

lesson.rule:
Kelajakni ifodalashda 3 xil asosiy shakl bor va ularni aralashtirmaslik muhim.

1. PRESENT CONTINUOUS (am/is/are + V-ing): Aniq vaqt va joyi kelishilgan rejadagi ishlar uchun ishlatiladi (kalendar yoki shartnoma qilingan).
2. BE GOING TO: Oldindan o'ylangan niyat, reja yoki yaqin kelajakdagi aniq alomatli bashoratlar uchun ishlatiladi.
3. WILL: Shu soniyada qabul qilingan qarorlar, shaxsiy fikr va ilmiy bo'lmagan bashoratlar (I think, I hope) uchun ishlatiladi.

O'zbek tilida hammasi ko'pincha '-aman/-ar' deb tarjima qilingani uchun o'quvchilar ko'p adashadi. Farqi: agar kalendarga yozib qo'ygan bo'lsang -ing, oldindan o'ylagan bo'lsang going to, hozirgina o'ylab gapirgan bo'lsang will ishlat.

examples.en: I am meeting the client at five.
examples.uz: Soat beshda mijoz bilan uchrashaman.
examples.note: Kelishilgan reja, shuning uchun Present Continuous.

examples.en: We are going to sign the contract tomorrow.
examples.uz: Ertaga shartnoma imzolaymiz.

examples.en: I think our profit will increase this year.
examples.uz: Menimcha, bu yil foydamiz oshadi.

examples.en: Look at the budget, we are losing money!
examples.uz: Byudjetga qarang, biz pul yo'qotyapmiz!
examples.note: Budget va profit/loss so'zlari moliya uchun muhim.
